description: bear shake on the beat at 105 bpm: both claws up from the first beat to the last, a new shape landed on every beat (up in a V, crossed in front, out flat, both swung to one side), while the four back legs step sideways one at a time, each coming down on a beat, lifted 30 mm, the body swaying fore and aft to keep its weight over the three feet down, 175 mm to the left and back, crouched, the body bobbing and shuddering three times a beat; ends in a W landed on a beat
